rows.note: Use 刺激 as the all-purpose noun for sensory input or an activity that produces excitement or pleasure.

example.english: The stimulation from this roller coaster makes me want to go again.
example.traditional: 呢個過山車帶嚟嘅刺激，我玩完仲想再玩。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwo3 saan1 ce1 daai2 lai4 ge3 ci3 gik1 ngo5 waan2 jyun4 zung6 soeng2 zoi3 waan2

rows.note: Use 鼓勵 for the supportive, positive kind of pushing someone toward action.

example.english: Your encouragement gave me the stimulation I needed to keep going.
example.traditional: 你一句鼓勵，真係畀咗我繼續捱落去嘅力量。
example.jyutping: nei5 jat1 geoi3 gu2 lai6 zan1 hai6 bei2 zo2 ngo5 gai3 zuk6 ngaai4 lok6 heoi3 ge3 lik6 loeng6

rows.note: Use 慫恿 when the urging pressures or goads someone into acting, usually with a disapproving implication.

example.english: The stimulation from their constant goading finally pushed me into gambling.
example.traditional: 佢哋成日慫恿我去賭錢，我終於忍唔住喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 sung2 jung2 ngo5 heoi3 dou2 cin2 ngo5 zung1 jyu1 jan2 m4 zyu6 laa3
